prompt: Two fighters circle each other. One lunges with a punch, the other dodges and falls. Slow push-in on the winner.
Ravi sneaks into the warehouse at night while a guard paces. Close-up on Ravi as he looks around. The guard turns and runs toward him.
Priya waves at Arjun. Arjun walks to her and they shake hands, then both laugh. Wide shot, orbit around them.
A zombie shambles toward a survivor. The survivor backs away, trips and falls, then crawls. Low angle on the zombie.
A tired soldier limps forward, stops and sits down. Close-up as he mopes. Crane up to end the scene.
Three dancers dance together at dusk while the camera orbits.
Two knights face each other and fight with swords. One knight falls backwards. The other raises his arms and celebrates.
A thief runs through the street. A cop chases him. The thief jumps and keeps running. Tracking shot.
A janitor sweeps the hallway, stops, stretches and yawns, then drinks from a bottle.
Meera and Kiran argue angrily. Kiran shrugs and walks away. Meera sits down and cries. Close-up on Meera.
A gymnast does a cartwheel, then a backflip, and takes a bow. Low angle.
A worker walks to a box, picks it up, then pushes a heavy crate. Over the shoulder shot.
Two boxers spar in the ring. The champion throws a punch and the challenger ducks, then kicks back. High angle.
Two friends meet in the park. They give each other a high five and laugh together.
A man staggers home drunk, falls on his face, then slowly gets back up.
A worker climbs a ladder while a guard looks around with a flashlight.
A kid hops on one foot, plays peekaboo and does a silly chicken dance. Handheld wide shot.
A dancer pirouettes gracefully on stage, then curtseys. Slow pull out.
A ninja creeps toward a guard and does a spinning kick. The guard collapses.
Arjun waits at the bar, waves at Priya, and she walks over and shakes his hand.
A chef chops vegetables in the kitchen, stirs the curry, then tastes it. Close-up on the chef.
Priya eats dinner from a plate while Arjun makes tea. Then they both sip chai.
Mom kneads dough for chapati while her son sets the table, then eats soup.
A woman brushes her teeth, makes coffee and answers the phone. Medium shot.
The sergeant shouts and the recruit drops and does pushups.
A coach does jumping jacks while an athlete does squats, then lifts weights.
